thread:
tom_sales: FYI - HarborGate procurement wants a compact assurance bundle to unblock their POC kickoff. Items requested: redacted SOC2 AOC, ISO27001 cert excerpt, signed pen-test attestation (they attached a 1-page form), and a single-page network diagram. They're asking for turnaround within 7 business days and asked for a short Dedicated trial price. Who can own each piece?

ria_security: We can provide redacted SOC2 AOC + ISO excerpt. If they request unredacted reports we'll require an NDA and internal review. For the attestation: need exact scope (hostnames/CIDRs) and whether Dedicated is in-scope. Also confirm whether they will run active scans or upload results.

vince_ops: If inbound scans are requested we need source CIDRs, a scheduled scan window, and an ops contact for a kill switch. Prefer presigned uploads. I can create the bucket/runbook once scope/method confirmed. Example presign I usually share:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/harborgate/harborgate-poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 604800
```
I'll include validators and emergency contact in the runbook.

julia_legal: I can sign the pen-test attestation on letterhead. Preconditions: (1) final scope string (hostnames/CIDRs + whether Dedicated is included), (2) PO or signed POC cover note referencing the engagement and billing entity. We'll issue an attestation only (no warranties). Turnaround ~48-72 hours after prerequisites are met.

owen_pricing: Short Dedicated trial uplift estimate: for a 2-week reserved mini-pool expect +20-25% over hosted list depending on GPU SKU. I can put together a one-line quote once @tom_sales confirms GPU class and whether they want the reserved window.

tom_sales: They attached a template via email and listed scope as "staging.harborgate.app". Procurement prefers hosted but security might request a light active scan. They also asked who signs and which contact to list.

julia_legal: Use me as signatory and @ria_security as technical contact in the attestation. Proposed scope wording for legal: "Scope: security testing limited to staging.harborgate.app and associated staging infrastructure for the HarborGate POC. Production systems and customer data are out-of-scope. Dedicated pool included only if explicitly purchased and referenced in the PO." Approve?

ria_security: That language looks good. Also note: we do not provide KMS keys or service account creds for customer testing. They can run scans from permitted IPs or upload results.

vince_ops: Created presigned bucket (standby) s3://redwood-evidence/harborgate/ - I'll finalize once @tom_sales confirms scans vs uploads and provides CIDRs if scans requested.

owen_pricing: Once we have Dedicated yes/no and GPU class I'll post a PO line-item. If they want the short trial priced into the PO, we can include it as a separate SKU.

tom_sales: I'll ask procurement to issue a short PO referencing the POC and confirm whether they will accept uploads-only. ETA EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:

artifact-bot: evidence: presigned bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/harborgate/ (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

julia_legal: Next steps: @tom_sales get customer template filled with final scope + PO or signed POC note. I will sign within 72 hours after receiving that. @vince_ops will finalize runbook after scan method confirmed. @owen_pricing will attach Dedicated line-item after GPU class confirmed.

tom_sales: On it - pinging HarborGate now. Will update thread when PO/scan preference confirmed.
